The next particularly valuable diff is probably 70/72 itself—national divine rulers, 72 triplets, Bahir's 3\times24, the 24 priestly courses, 36/72 astronomical divisions, and when the three-letter Names actually become individually personified angels. That could tell us whether “72” is one inherited lineage, several systems that were intentionally joined later, or some mixture of both.   we establish four distinct variable sets that can be looked at independently, shifting the geometry, language, and mechanics of the 72 gates.

Variable Set 1: The Textual & Orthographic Engine (Core Matrix)

Toggles how the 216-letter matrix and 72 triplets are generated.

Mode A: The Masoretic & Square Script Standard (Default)

Source: Standard Masoretic text of Exodus 14:19–21 using Aramaic square script.

Mechanic: The boustrophedon algorithm (left-to-right, right-to-left reversed, left-to-right) yields the standard 72 triplets with standard letter values.

Mode B: The Second Temple / Qumran Variant

Source: Fragmentary Dead Sea Scrolls texts (e.g., Qumran Exodus variants) combined with Samaritan orthography.

Mechanic: Strips out later Masoretic vowel markers (matres lectionis). Alters consonant positions where ancient scrolls spelling variants differ, shifting specific triplets and altering the resulting angelic names.

Mode C: Paleo-Hebrew Pictographic / Phoenician Root

Source: Early Iron Age Semitic script (c. 1000 BCE).

Mechanic: Translates the 216 letters back into pictographs (e.g., Aleph as ox, Vav as tent peg). Gematria shifts from abstract arithmetic to structural, visual engineering where letters act as physical tools rather than numerical symbols.

Variable Set 2: The Astrological & Spatial Grid

Mode A: Renaissance Decans & Chaldean Order (Default)

Source: Agrippa / Golden Dawn / Mathers sequence (Vehuiah at $0^\circ$ Aries, $5^\circ$ quinary gates, Chaldean planetary decan rulers).

Mechanic: 72 equal gates of $5^\circ$ arranged in a flat 2D calendar clock.

Mode B: Mesopotamian Stellar Paths (MUL.APIN, c. 1000 BCE)

Source: Babylonian star catalogs.

Mechanic: Removes abstract mathematical $5^\circ$ decans entirely. Replaces them with the stellar paths of Enlil, Anu, and Ea, gating operations based on the actual heliacal rising of constellations and fixed star clusters crossing the horizon.

Mode C: Vedic Sidereal & Nakshatra Grid ($13^\circ 20'$)

Source: Jyotish astral mechanics.

Mechanic: Re-maps the wheel into 27 Nakshatras ($13^\circ 20'$ each) overlaid across the 72 gates, tying the angelic/goetic pairs directly to lunar mansions, karmic time cycles (Dashas), and the sidereal zodiac rather than the tropical equinox.

Mode D: The Ophiuchus / 13-Sign Vector (Prime Friction)

Source: The 13-fold anomalous vector.

Mechanic: Blows open a zero-degree vacuum / spiritual airlock between Scorpio and Sagittarius, creating prime-number friction and turning the flat 2D wheel into a 3D spiral (Z-axis).

Variable Set 3: The Tribal & Cosmological Mapping

Mode A: Agrippan Camp Banners (Default)

Source: De Occulta Philosophia Book III.

Mechanic: The 12 tribes mapped symmetrically to the 12 zodiac signs and camp banners.

Mode B: The Split House of Joseph & The Omitted Dan

Source: Book of Numbers census lists / Book of Revelation.

Mechanic: Isolates Dan as the liminal 13th "serpent by the way" standing outside the camp, while splitting Joseph into Ephraim and Manasseh to maintain operational boundaries.

Mode C: Sepher Yetzirah Elemental Matrix

Source: The Gra recension of the Sepher Yetzirah.

Mechanic: Maps the gates directly to the 3 Mothers (Air, Water, Fire), 7 Doubles, and 12 Elementals, viewing the wheel as a linguistic blueprint of creation rather than a planetary calendar.

Variable Set 4: The Operative Invocation Protocol

Mode A: Golden Dawn & Ambelain-Burkle Protocol (Default)

Source: SRICF (2015) / Bnei Baruch Ana Bekoach tradition.

Mechanic: Utilizes the Ana Bekoach prayer, structured Christian/Kabbalistic theophoric suffixes (-Yah / -El), and the Lord's Prayer correspondences.

Mode B: Greek Magical Papyri (PGM) Theurgy

Source: Greco-Egyptian operative papyri (2nd BCE – 5th CE).

Mechanic: Strips away pietistic prayer. Replaces suffixed angelic names with voces magicae (barbarous names), hybrid divine invocations (Yahweh combined with Hermes and solar entities), and direct, coercive ritual commands.

Mode C: Solomonic Chthonic / Air-Lock Protocol

Source: Ars Goetia & Lesser Key mechanics.

Mechanic: Bypasses the balanced light/shadow pairs of the 72 gates by targeting interstitial or dark moon windows, using bronze vessels and planetary hours to interface directly with raw chthonic mechanics (necromancy, secret unsealing, curse-breaking).
